scenes.narration: Every animal cell has a nucleus that holds DNA, a cell membrane that controls what enters and leaves, mitochondria that generate energy, and a cytoplasm that fills the cell.
scenes.visualDescription: Anatomy of a cell with labelled parts.
scenes.concept: Animal cells have four key structures: nucleus, membrane, mitochondria, and cytoplasm.

visual.title: Inside an Animal Cell
visual.subject: circle
visual.footnote: The nucleus is the largest organelle in most animal cells.
